name: vlogops
description: BUILD-006 Phases 1-4 — the durable Content Seed store, the three human-initiated intake routes, the Source Compiler, Scribe, and Verification that can BLOCK. A seed's identity is a function of its content and nothing else; captured source bytes are frozen at intake so a source edited, corrupted or deleted afterwards cannot rewrite history; the same source taken in twice yields one seed; and an intake killed mid-flight recovers to exactly one correct state with nobody re-running it. The compiler turns a sealed seed into a bounded, deduplicated, chronological, provenance-complete evidence pack whose identity is likewise a pure function of its content, reading only the frozen snapshots and never the original source. Scribe turns that pack into a versioned Master Story Package: one canonical creative truth, with script, blog, titles and thumbnail direction stored as projections of cited rows, so a sibling that cites nothing, cites outside the pack, or asserts something the master does not is unwritable rather than merely discouraged. Verification then stands between that package and everything downstream and can stop it: five dimensions — fact, quotation, privacy, rights and cross-format consistency — each answering for itself with its own coverage, and a block that is a durable recorded state rather than a returned boolean, enforced by a database trigger on the advance operation so that a failing package cannot be moved on by any client until a named person records an override or an answer. Additive-only `vlogops` schema — it never touches asdair, session_report, ops, tower or any other namespace.
